verdict.rationale: GitBook documents interactive API playgrounds: you add an OpenAPI specification and readers can test endpoints right on the page with interactive blocks. That covers both the interactive reference and the runnable-examples parts of the story. The evidence is thin, though: only a pricing bullet and one docs line, with no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the playground's runnable examples (auth, generated code samples), independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence that GitBook's own API reference uses the playground.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: let your users test endpoints right on the page with interactive blocks
